concursos.limite: Test configuration. It does not resolve competitions or change Personnel records.
concursos.ayuda_texto: Select a case. Adjust the date, coefficients, tables and caps. Compare the initial result and draft. The cut-off date is excluded from the calculation. Ranges compare the personal grade or level held against the requested position level. Save the draft to a file to resume later.
concursos.pendiente: Compare the configuration to see its effect.
concursos.pendiente_datos: Data is missing to calculate the total. Review the issues.
concursos.activacion_pendiente: Activation requires approved terms, review, authorisation and signature.
concursos.puntos_invalidos: Enter a non-negative score with up to six decimal places.
concursos.nivel_invalido: Enter a whole number from −999 to 999.
concursos.validacion: Review the highlighted fields before comparing.
concursos.archivo_invalido: The file does not contain valid competition rules. Check it and load it again.
concursos.reglas_invalidas: The configuration is invalid. Review the dates, ranges and caps.
concursos.simulacion_fallida: The comparison could not be calculated. Check the connection and retry.
concursos.respuesta_invalida: No valid result was received. Compare again.
concursos.sin_reglas: No categories match this search. Change the filter.
concursos.perder_cambios: The draft has changes. Do you want to discard them?
concursos.unidad_anos_desde_meses: Per year based on eligible months
concursos.conversion_anos_desde_meses: Months ÷ {divisor}; add a year if the remainder exceeds {umbral} · {agrupacion}
concursos.motivo_computado: Eligible data: {unidades} units. The score is shown in the category breakdown.
concursos.motivo_conversion_y_coeficiente: Scoring units: {unidades}. Points per unit: {coeficiente}. Before cap: {bruto}. Cap: {tope}. Result: {neto}.
concursos.motivo_suma_horas: Eligible hours: {unidades}. Points per hour: {coeficiente}. Before cap: {bruto}. Cap: {tope}. Result: {neto}.
concursos.motivo_tope_tramo: Range cap. Before cap: {bruto}. Cap: {tope}. Result: {neto}.
concursos.motivo_fuera_ventana: Outside the eligible period. Not scored.
concursos.motivo_posterior_corte: Date on or after the cut-off date. Not counted.
concursos.motivo_usado_requisito: Used as an entry requirement. This rule excludes its score.
concursos.motivo_tipo_no_admitido: Merit type not accepted by this rule. Not scored.
concursos.motivo_no_relacionado: Course without a verified relationship to the position. Not scored.
concursos.motivo_caducado: Validity ends before the cut-off date. Not scored.
concursos.motivo_horas_insuficientes: The course does not meet the rule’s minimum hours. Not scored.
concursos.motivo_limite_elementos: This rule’s maximum number of merits has been reached. Not scored.
concursos.motivo_desconocido: No explanation is available for this detail. Review the category breakdown.
